subject: BlueHarbor OEM embed: technical + commercial sync
messages:
From: Chris Dalton <chris.dalton@blueharborpay.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Aggarwal <priya.aggarwal@blueharborpay.com>
Date: 2027-05-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + request: embedding Redwood runtime into BlueHarbor SDK

Hi Laura,

Quick intro — I'm Chris (Head of Integrations at BlueHarbor). We're exploring embedding a third-party inference runtime into our payments SDK so merchants can run conversational assistants and reconciliation helpers locally in the merchant environment or as a managed option. Your platform came highly recommended by a few partners.

High-level asks from our side:
- White-label/embedded runtime that we can ship as part of the BlueHarbor SDK with co-branding controls
- Support for both managed (hosted) and private (VPC / on-prem) deployments for regulated merchants
- SSO + per-merchant tenant isolation + optional KMS/HSM integration
- Clear SLAs for latency (p95 token latency target) and availability for dedicated capacity
- Ability to expose a slim public surface for our customers while Redwood maintains the model and operational patches
- Telemetry hooks (token-level cost estimates, per-route latency) and audit logs for compliance evidence

We'd like to set up a 45–60 min technical + commercial sync next week to align on feasibility, high-level architecture, POC scope, and an indicative pricing band. I've attached a short architecture overview (see attachment) and a sketch of our desired MAP (mutual action plan).

Proposed agenda:
1) Integration patterns (SDK embed vs sidecar vs managed API)
2) Data residency & encryption options
3) Rollout model & entitlements (co-branding, white-label licensing)
4) Indicative pricing + procurement path
5) Timeline for POC (30-day quickstart)

Are you available Tue/Wed next week afternoon PST? If easier, loop in who on your side owns partner OEMs and commercial packaging.

Thanks — looking forward to a short sync.

Chris Dalton
Head of Integrations | BlueHarbor Payments
chris.dalton@blueharborpay.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachment: blueharbor_arch_overview.pdf (diagram, 2 pages)

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Chris Dalton <chris.dalton@blueharborpay.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-27T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + request: embedding Redwood runtime into BlueHarbor SDK

Hi Chris — great to meet you (virtually) and thanks for the clear brief. Laura here — I run Partner Integrations at Redwood.

We'd be excited to explore this with BlueHarbor. Marissa (partnership ops) and Karthik (product & commercial lead for OEM) are looped in. Proposed times look good; we have availability:
- Tue 2027-05-31 13:00–14:00 PST
- Wed 2027-06-01 15:00–16:00 PST

I've sketched a short agenda to keep the call focused:
- 10m: intros + success criteria
- 20m: technical options (embed runtime vs sidecar vs thin API) + security controls
- 10m: commercial guardrails (license model, co-branding policies, entitlement surface)
- 5m: MAP and next steps (POC milestones, support, contracting steps)

A few quick answers up front that will help the call:
- Deployment options: Redwood supports hosted (API), Dedicated reserved pools, and Private (VPC / on-prem) — all can be configured with tenant isolation and KMS integrations.
- Latency: we typically publish p95 latency for a model variant and can commit to dedicated pool SLO targets in an MPA for enterprise partners.
- Co-branding: we have a white-label partner program that allows partner-facing UI skinning within limits (we manage logo placement and security notices).
- Legal: our standard OEM term sheet includes audit, data-handling, and a confidentiality addendum; Marissa will coordinate legal and package a first draft.

Could you attach any compliance checklists or minimum-security requirements you must meet for merchants? That will help us prepare a scoped POC proposal.

Confirming the proposed time (Wed 2027-06-01 15:00 PST) would work for us; if that works for you, we'll send a calendar invite with the agenda and a short pre-read (term-sheet + technical options).

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Partner Integrations | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com

--
Redwood Inference — production-first inference for product teams

From: Chris Dalton <chris.dalton@blueharborpay.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Aggarwal <priya.aggarwal@blueharborpay.com>, BlueHarbor Payments Legal <legal@blueharborpay.com>
Date: 2027-05-28T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + request: embedding Redwood runtime into BlueHarbor SDK

Laura, thanks — Wed 2027-06-01 15:00 PST works for us.

Attached is a slightly more detailed list of technical constraints and an architecture sketch (see attachment). A few items to highlight before the call:
- We need an offline embedding mode for certain POS terminals (local inference without egress). Is there a supported on-prem runtime footprint for quantized LLMs?
- We expect merchant telemetry to be scrubbed before it leaves the merchant boundary; explicit token-level data egress rules are required in the contract.
- Co-branding: we prefer BlueHarbor-first UX in merchant-facing flows; we will accept a small Redwood badge in the admin console only.
- Revenue/monetization: we're evaluating both a revenue-share model for value-add features and a per-seat/per-merchant licensing for the embedded runtime. Any indicative price bands you can share would be useful for our procurement team ahead of the meeting.

Also attaching a public copy of our standard vendor security questionnaire — legal will appreciate a response in the first round.

Regards,
Chris

Attachment: blueharbor_arch_overview.pdf (updated, 3 pages)
Attachment: blueharbor_vendor_security_qs.xlsx (stub)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-28T10:40:00-07:00
Subject: RE: BlueHarbor OEM embed: technical + commercial sync (pre-call notes)

Quick internal notes for the sync on Wednesday:
- Technical: We should present three integration patterns with tradeoffs: 1) Embedded quantized runtime (lightweight binary + model shard) for on-prem; 2) Sidecar managed by partner but hosted in their VPC with our control plane; 3) Managed API (hosted Redwood) with prefix/KV caching to meet latency SLOs.
- Security: confirm KMS/HSM options, token scrubbing, and SOC2 artifacts. Ask for the vendor security questionnaire responses ahead of time.
- Commercials: propose 3-tier OEM pricing: dev/test free tier for partners, per-merchant seat band for on-prem licenses, and committed monthly throughput for managed/dedicated. Keep flexibility for revenue-share pilots.
- POC: offer a 30-day POC with limited production traffic cap, monitoring dashboard access, and a joint success checklist (uptime p99 target, latency p95, and telemetry verification).

I'll draft a short pre-read with the integration patterns, estimated costs, and a starter MAP. Marissa — can you prepare the term-sheet draft and flag any legal blockers?

Karthik
Product Partnerships | Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-29T07:15:00-07:00
Subject: RE: BlueHarbor OEM embed: technical + commercial sync (legal/commercial prep)

Laura/Karthik —
I've started a redline for an OEM term sheet (filename: redwood_oem-term-sheet_v1.docx). Key commercial points I'm recommending:
- Term: 12 month initial term with automatic renewal unless terminated with 60 days notice.
- Pricing: three tracks as Karthik suggested; include an enterprise committed throughput discount for Dedicated pools.
- Co-branding: partner-first; Redwood reserved right to simple accreditation/branding in admin interfaces only.
- Audit/data access: we will provide SOC2 artifacts, and for on-prem deployments we offer a support window for security audits but do not ingest merchant PII by default.
- Support: partner success onboarding + 8x5 email support for POC; upsell to 24x7 for dedicated SLA.

I'll upload the draft to the drive folder and include comments for the call. Also recommend we bring someone from Legal on the call if BlueHarbor's legal rep will be present.

Marissa Cole
Head of Partnership Operations | Redwood Inference

--
Final: Wed 2027-06-01 15:00 PST: calendar invite sent, pre-read attached (term-sheet + integration patterns).
